rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act or service of cutting hair.

example.english: I’m going for a haircut tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 zin2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when you mean the hairstyle or shape produced by the cut, rather than the cutting itself.

example.english: I want to change my haircut.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zyun2 go3 faat3 jing4
